title: ParseX validationResult Payload
description: Kind-specific payload for kind=validationResult. Formalizes the existing ValidationResult/ValidationError type (PAR-98): flat error list with severity, stable code, message, and optional location/context. Documentation/formalization only — not a redesign of that type.

passed.description: True when errors contains no Error-severity entries.

code.description: Stable check id, e.g. schema.invalid, ref.dangling, shortname.duplicate, can.dlc_mismatch, can.signal_overlap.

location.description: Source span; omitted entirely when not attributable (omit-over-null per CONVENTIONS.md).

path.description: REF path / parent path; omitted when the check does not set it.

expectedType.description: DEST expectation; omitted when the check does not set it.

actualType.description: Resolved tag / second signal; omitted when the check does not set it.
